items.q: Reed Sternberg cells characteristically express which marker pair?
items.exp: Classic Reed Sternberg cells express CD30 and CD15 with weak PAX5 and usually no CD20. Popcorn cells of the nodular lymphocyte predominant type reverse this with CD20 positivity.
r: Incorrect. CD20 marks most B cell non Hodgkin lymphomas.
Correct. CD30 plus CD15 defines classic Hodgkin cells.
Incorrect. Those are T cell markers.
Incorrect. CD138 marks plasma cell neoplasms.
items.kp: Hodgkin classic: CD30 and CD15. Popcorn type: CD20.

items.q: Large binucleate cells with owl eye nucleoli in a reactive background define which cell?
items.exp: The owl eye binucleate Reed Sternberg cell is the diagnostic malignant cell of classic Hodgkin lymphoma, scarce within reactive tissue. Excision biopsy preserves the architecture needed to find it.
r: Incorrect. Lacunar cells are the nodular sclerosis variant with retraction space.
Correct. Owl eye binucleate cells are Reed Sternberg cells.
Incorrect. Popcorn cells are multilobed LP cells of the other entity.
Incorrect. Flame cells occur in myeloma marrow.
items.kp: Owl eyes in reactive tissue equal Hodgkin lymphoma.

items.q: Which Hodgkin subtype most often presents with a bulky mediastinal mass in young women?
items.exp: Nodular sclerosis Hodgkin lymphoma is commonest overall, affects young women and forms mediastinal masses with lacunar cells and collagen bands dividing nodules.
r: Incorrect. Depleted type affects older and HIV patients with disseminated disease.
Correct. Nodular sclerosis favours young women and mediastinum.
Incorrect. Mixed cellularity links more with EBV and older patients.
Incorrect. Predominant type favours young men with single peripheral nodes.
items.kp: Young woman plus mediastinal mass: nodular sclerosis Hodgkin.

items.q: B symptoms in lymphoma staging comprise which triad?
o: Fever, night sweats, over 10 percent weight loss
items.exp: B symptoms are unexplained fever above 38 degrees, drenching night sweats and loss exceeding ten percent of body weight in six months. They worsen prognosis at any stage.
r: Correct. Fever, sweats and major weight loss are B symptoms.
Incorrect. That triad describes local inflammation.
Incorrect. Those reflect marrow failure, not B notation.
Incorrect. Respiratory symptoms localise disease but are not B symptoms.
items.kp: Learn B symptoms by weight percentage and drenching sweats.

items.q: Why is excision biopsy preferred over fine needle aspiration in Hodgkin lymphoma?
o: Tumour cells are too large for needles
Scarce Reed Sternberg cells need preserved architecture and background
Needles spread lymphoma along tracts routinely
Flow cytometry is impossible on nodes
items.exp: Malignant cells form under one percent of Hodgkin tissue, so diagnosis needs excised architecture showing them in proper reactive background. Aspirates sample mainly reactive cells and mislead.
r: Incorrect. Size is not the limiting factor.
Correct. Architecture and scarce cells demand excision.
Incorrect. Tract seeding is not the stated reason.
Incorrect. Flow helps non Hodgkin workups but misses Hodgkin scarcity.
items.kp: Hodgkin diagnosis needs the whole node, not a needle sample.

items.q: Contiguous spread from one node group to the next most favours which lymphoma class?
items.exp: Hodgkin lymphoma spreads predictably through contiguous lymphatic groups, enabling stage based field planning historically. Non Hodgkin lymphomas spread non contiguously and haematogenously earlier.
r: Incorrect. Non Hodgkin spread is non contiguous and widespread.
Correct. Contiguous spread characterises Hodgkin lymphoma.
Incorrect. Myeloma is marrow based without this nodal pattern.
Incorrect. Blood phase is not a spread pattern of nodes.
items.kp: Orderly contiguous nodes point to Hodgkin disease.

items.q: Popcorn shaped tumour cells expressing CD20 with absent CD30 indicate which entity?
o: Diffuse large B cell lymphoma always
items.exp: Nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma has LP popcorn cells retaining B cell markers like CD20 without CD30 or CD15, behaving indolently and treated differently from classic disease.
r: Incorrect. Classic types express CD30 without strong CD20.
Correct. Popcorn CD20 cells define the predominant entity.
Incorrect. Large B cell lymphoma sheets tumour cells without this background.
Incorrect. Anaplastic lymphoma strongly expresses CD30.
items.kp: Popcorn plus CD20 separates this Hodgkin entity completely.

items.q: Which virus is found within Reed Sternberg cells in many mixed cellularity cases?
items.exp: Epstein Barr virus latent proteins rescue crippled germinal centre B cells in many Hodgkin cases, especially mixed cellularity, lymphocyte depleted and HIV associated disease.
r: Incorrect. HHV 8 drives Kaposi sarcoma and primary effusion lymphoma.
Correct. Epstein Barr virus inhabits many Reed Sternberg cells.
Incorrect. HTLV 1 causes adult T cell leukaemia lymphoma.
Incorrect. Hepatitis B links to polyarteritis and liver cancer risk.
items.kp: EBV rescues the crippled B cell that becomes Reed Sternberg.

items.q: Brentuximab vedotin targets which antigen on Hodgkin tumour cells?
items.exp: Brentuximab is an anti CD30 antibody drug conjugate delivering chemotherapy directly to Reed Sternberg cells. CD30 targeting is rational precisely because classic Hodgkin cells uniformly express it.
r: Incorrect. Rituximab targets CD20 in B cell lymphomas.
Correct. Brentuximab targets CD30.
Incorrect. Alemtuzumab targets CD52 in other settings.
Incorrect. HER2 targeting belongs to breast and gastric cancers.
items.kp: CD30 on the cell means brentuximab can find it.

items.q: Worst prognosis classic Hodgkin subtype with many tumour cells and HIV association is which?
items.exp: Lymphocyte depleted Hodgkin lymphoma has abundant malignant cells, scant reactive background, disseminated presentation and HIV association, carrying the worst classic prognosis.
r: Incorrect. Lymphocyte rich has favourable prognosis.
Incorrect. Nodular sclerosis is commonest with good outcomes.
Correct. Lymphocyte depleted carries the worst prognosis.
Incorrect. Predominant type is indolent and separate.
items.kp: Fewest reactive cells, worst Hodgkin prognosis: depleted type.
